marta: Triage q for the team — I sketched a concise approach to unify hosting modes: a minimal runtime contract + a short list of stable capability flags + a tiny diagnostics payload. idea is to make the SDK surface identical while letting adapters be thin. thoughts?

kai: short answer: yes. keep core semantics tiny. my worry: behavioral drift in adapters over time. we need a conformance suite that runs in CI.

devon: agreed. for secrets the core MUST only carry opaque refs (e.g. `secret://proj/thing`) and never key material. adapters map the ref to local KMS/HSM calls. auditors will like that.

marta: exactly — core treats secrets as strings and validates schema only. adapters implement handlers.

sam: telemetry: propose adapters must populate three trace tags: `hosting.mode`, `tenant_normalized`, `adapter_id`. also expose `adapter.reported_capabilities` in diagnostics endpoint. dashboards rely on that.

lee: add a compact capability set (enumerated): `streaming`, `kv_cache`, `quantization:{none,8,4}`, `hsm_signing`. adapters return a map, but runtime can read it as a vector for fast checks.

marta: runtime behavior: if request asks for streaming but adapter lacks it, return structured JSON error with stable code and hint, e.g. `{code:412, reason:"capability_missing", hint:"fallback:polling"}`. apps can react.

kai: migration plan: header `X-Adapter-Compat: legacy|compact-v1`. control plane can inject a shim for `legacy`. that lets us roll across Dedicated -> Private -> Hosted gradually.

devon: security contract: adapters must not log plaintext secrets or export keys to hosted logs. require this as a must-pass conformance check. also require a signed audit entry for key material access in private mode.

sam: ops-bot: please create a ticket for the conformance harness and an alert rule for capability mismatches at runtime. we want a metric `adapter.capability_mismatch.count` and an alert when it spikes.

ops-bot: infra-bot created INF-9007: adapter-compact-conformance + runtime-mismatch-alerting. ETA 3 sprints.

lee: small addition: allow request-level hints `desired_latency_ms` and `cost_sensitivity` so adapters can pick kernels/quant profiles. advisory only. record both values in traces.

marta: nice. next steps: I'll draft RFC with the compact schema, diagnostics payload example, and migration checklist. kai/devon to draft shim semantics and the conformance tests. sam to update tracing + alerting docs. ping me if you want to review. :sparkles:
